name: httpGet
description: Issue an HTTP GET against a public URL via the Chromium net stack. Runs in the browser process (NOT subject to renderer CORS). Used by WebFetch's URL retrieval and available to any future TS-side tool that needs to fetch a URL through the same network stack the LLM providers use. Response body returned as bytes via the bridge's binary transport. Redirects: by default the loader returns a 3xx response with the Location header intact; pass followRedirects=true to follow up to maxRedirects hops.

inputs.name: url
inputs.description: Absolute http(s) URL to GET. Caller is responsible for length-cap, credentials-stripping, and scheme validation.

inputs.name: headers
inputs.description: Optional request headers — a map of string -> string. Do NOT include Authorization here (LLM-provider concern; see api/llm/providers/* for that path).

inputs.name: timeoutMs
inputs.description: Hard timeout in milliseconds; the loader is cancelled past this. Default 60_000 when omitted.

inputs.name: maxResponseBytes
inputs.description: Cap on response-body size; the loader aborts once this many bytes have been received. Default 50_000_000 (50 MB) when omitted.

inputs.name: followRedirects
inputs.description: If false (default), 3xx responses are returned to the caller AS-IS so the caller can apply its own redirect policy (e.g. same-host-only). If true, the loader follows redirects up to maxRedirects hops.

inputs.name: maxRedirects
inputs.description: Maximum number of redirects to follow when followRedirects=true. Default 10.
